mapper.sql: r.id AS `cursor`, r.id AS jobId, r.job_type AS jobType, r.status AS status, r.attempts AS attempts, r.next_run_at AS nextRunAt, r.lease_until AS leaseUntil, (r.status='RUNNING' AND r.lease_until <= #{at}) AS leaseExpired, r.last_error AS lastError, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.version AS version
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT last_error FROM tc_job_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_type='REFUND_RECOVER' AND business_key=#{number} AND status IN ('READY','RUNNING','REVIEW')

SELECT 'ORDER' AS resourceType,o.order_no AS resourceNo,o.business_no AS businessNo FROM tc_job_lease j JOIN tc_order o ON o.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND o.order_no=j.business_key WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND j.id=#{number} AND j.job_type='ORDER_RESOLVE' UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYMENT',p.payment_no,p.business_no FROM tc_job_lease j JOIN tc_payment_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND a.merchant_request_no=j.business_key JOIN tc_payment_intent p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.id=a.intent_id WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND j.id=#{number} AND j.job_type='PAYMENT_RECOVER' UNION ALL SELECT 'REFUND',r.refund_no,r.business_no FROM tc_job_lease j JOIN tc_refund r ON r.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND r.refund_no=j.business_key WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND j.id=#{number} AND j.job_type='REFUND_RECOVER' UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYMENT_RECEIPT',r.receipt_no,r.business_no FROM tc_job_lease j JOIN tc_payment_receipt r ON r.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND r.receipt_no=j.business_key WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND j.id=#{number} AND j.job_type='REFUND_COMPENSATE' UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYMENT_CALLBACK',c.callback_no,c.business_no FROM tc_job_lease j JOIN tc_payment_callback c ON c.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND c.callback_no=j.business_key WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND j.id=#{number} AND j.job_type='PAYMENT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT 'REFUND_CALLBACK',c.callback_no,c.business_no FROM tc_job_lease j JOIN tc_refund_callback c ON c.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND c.callback_no=j.business_key WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND j.id=#{number} AND j.job_type='REFUND_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT 'OUTBOX_EVENT',o.event_id,NULL FROM tc_job_lease j JOIN tc_outbox o ON o.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND o.event_id=j.business_key WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND j.id=#{number} AND j.job_type='OUTBOX_PUBLISH' UNION ALL SELECT 'RECONCILIATION_OPERATION',o.operation_no,o.business_no FROM tc_job_lease j JOIN tc_reconciliation_operation o ON o.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND o.operation_no=j.business_key WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND j.id=#{number} AND j.job_type='RECON_QUERY'
